# Sigtake

> Real-time alert management & monitoring for ops teams. Sigtake ingests alerts
> from all your systems, collapses duplicates into one row, and routes what
> matters to the right team — by email, Slack, Microsoft Teams or in-app. Uptime,
> signal and heartbeat monitoring included.

## Product
- [Features](https://sigtake.com/#features): alert deduplication, routing, multi-tenant workspaces
- [SDKs](https://sigtake.com/#how): official Node and Python clients
- [Monitoring](https://sigtake.com/#monitoring): uptime and signal monitoring built in
- [Heartbeats](https://sigtake.com/#heartbeats): cron jobs, backups, workers and on-demand jobs that ping Sigtake;
  a missed ping, a failure or a hung run is an alert
- [How it works](https://sigtake.com/#how): connect, route, then acknowledge and resolve
- [Pricing](https://sigtake.com/pricing/): free during early access — unlimited users, teams and
  alerts, plus website, signal and heartbeat monitoring (up to 100 heartbeats per organization), no credit
  card; paid plans as we grow

## SDKs
- Node.js: `npm install @sigtake/sdk` (Node 18+, zero dependencies, ESM + CJS, typed).
  https://www.npmjs.com/package/@sigtake/sdk
- Python: `pip install sigtake` (Python 3.10+, sync and async, typed).
  https://pypi.org/project/sigtake/
- Both expose the same surface: `alerts.ingest({title, severity, source, team_code, payload})`
  and `signals.send(source, {metric: value})`. The API key resolves tenant and project, so
  there is no project id to pass.

## Notification channels
- Live: email, Slack, Microsoft Teams, in-app (in-app push is always on and not configurable).
- In progress: Discord, Google Chat.
- Slack: one workspace per organization, a separate Slack channel per project.
  Repeat occurrences of an incident reply in the thread of the first card and update it in place.
- Routing: the API key decides the project, the alert's team_code decides the team, and that team's
  channels in the project decide where it lands.

## Signals & monitoring
- Push numeric metrics via API (`POST /api/signals/ingest`); rules evaluate every minute.
- Rule types: threshold (avg/min/max/last over a window), anomaly detection
  (learns normal by hour & weekday, no threshold), and missing signal (alerts when a metric stops reporting).
- Signal alerts flow into the same dedup, routing and notification pipeline.
- Website/uptime monitoring: periodic checks with uptime % and latency trends.

## Heartbeats
- A job reports to a private URL: `https://api.sigtake.com/ping/<token>` (GET, POST or HEAD; the body is
  never read; success answers 204 with no body). `/start` opens a run, `/fail` reports a failure, `/<exit code>`
  reports 0 as success and 1-255 as failure.
- Schedule: an interval (1 minute to 31 days), a cron expression with an IANA timezone, or on demand. A grace
  window (1 minute to 7 days) applies to scheduled heartbeats. With `/start`, an optional maximum run duration
  alerts on a run that takes too long, and a run still open at the next deadline alerts as started and never finished.
- On demand: no schedule, never alerts on silence; alerts only on a reported failure or a run past its
  maximum duration (required). `?rid=<id>` tracks concurrent runs one by one.
- A missed deadline opens `Heartbeat down: <name>` (high severity), routed to the heartbeat's team through the
  project's channels, deduplicated, and resolved automatically by the next successful run. A heartbeat whose
  first ping never arrives also alerts.
- Tokens can be rotated, optionally keeping the old URL valid for 1 hour, 1 day or 7 days. History keeps 14
  days of pings. Up to 100 heartbeats per organization.
- Not an on-call system and no job output capture.

## Academy
Practical guides for small ops teams: https://sigtake.com/academy/
- [Replacing Opsgenie on a Small Team](https://sigtake.com/academy/opsgenie-alternative-small-teams/): Opsgenie shuts down on
  April 5, 2027; concept map, step-by-step migration, and when Sigtake is the wrong replacement (no on-call schedules,
  escalations or phone/SMS paging)
- [Alert Deduplication](https://sigtake.com/academy/alert-deduplication-alert-fatigue/): fingerprint is
  source|title|severity per project; notifications at occurrences 1, 10, 25, 50, 100, then every 100
- [Alert Notification Channels](https://sigtake.com/academy/alert-notification-channels-slack-teams-email/): who email,
  Slack and Microsoft Teams channels reach, Slack threading, turning a channel off
- [Alert Routing by Team](https://sigtake.com/academy/alert-routing-by-team/): every alert belongs to one team via its
  team_code; teams span projects, channels are per project
- [Set Up Alert Notifications](https://sigtake.com/academy/set-up-alert-notifications/): team, project, channel, test alert
- [Website Uptime Monitoring](https://sigtake.com/academy/website-uptime-monitoring/): what counts as down, interval x
  failure threshold, auto-resolve on recovery; slow responses don't alert; expiring certificates get their own
  alert (14 days ahead by default, reminders at 7, 3 and 1)
- [Monitor an Authenticated API Health Endpoint](https://sigtake.com/academy/monitor-api-health-endpoint/): encrypted
  write-only secret headers (Bearer, API key, Basic), JSONPath assertions (equals, contains, exists, not empty)
- [Cron Job Monitoring](https://sigtake.com/academy/cron-job-monitoring-silent-failures/): why a job that never
  runs leaves no trace; heartbeats with /start and exit codes, on-demand jobs with run ids, choosing the grace
  window, and what a heartbeat can't catch
